failure.requirement: A policy may be selected only when it has an applicable valid revision and binding; otherwise the request must receive null decision, matched revision, and reason.
failure.instruction_quote: Requests with no applicable policy must still produce a row with null decision, matched revision, and reason.
failure.explanation: The rewritten query retained policy-definition fields through a left join even when no valid revision/binding existed, producing entries such as decision='deny' and reason='r18' with matched_policy_revision=null. At step 8 the agent tested only a straightforward unmatched request and did not exercise policies lacking an applicable revision or binding, then prematurely declared completion in steps 10-11.
